limitations: Single captured trial per scenario; paired ablations only, no statistical or corpus-recall claim.
B/C-small isolates qualification, C-small/C pool size, C/D adaptive expansion. Top-12 prefixes stand in for top-6 responses.
Missing slots score zero with fixed denominator six. Duplicate platform identities count once. A may select more than six; selectedCount preserves that.
Text and indexed frame metadata do not prove whole-video constraints; image review is separate.
Initial labels are primary; rich subset changes remain separate and never silently replace them.
Top-1 source proximity is diagnostic only. Actual generated approach count, grounding, distinctness and closest-approach-first remain pending separate postproduction review.
Source and plan fidelity differ; plan capability fidelity is not measured by source labels.
